name: save-boot-7c-world-kalm-presses
description: Diagnostic for #140 (why the save-booted world map did not move under the pad in #80 attempt 3). Signs only (-1/0/1) for positions and angles; no coordinate leaves the run. Load as save-boot-7-world-kalm does (Circle every 30 frames until g_GameState 3). Then 600 frames, three Circle and three Cross presses one second apart (to close a dialogue or event, if one holds the world map), a mark, 120 frames of Up and 10 still. Reported: g_GameState (still 3?), wl_state, camera view, flags1 and the signs of the change since the mark of pos.vx/vz and direction.

wl_state.description: World overlay D_800E566C (s32, low half): the world loop's state. WORLD_Main sets it to -15 and WmUpdateWorldState counts it up to 0, then sets 1 (playing) and starts the fade-in; 2 is the menu, 3/8 a field or battle exit, >= 6 leaves the loop. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c WORLD_Main, WmUpdateWorldState.

cam.description: World overlay D_800E5648 (s32, low half): the camera view (WmSetCamView). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

flags1.description: Player actor + 0x51 flags1: bit 0x10 is set by WmScriptDisableForPcEntity(1) (the script disables the player), bit 0x80 means its position needs recalculating. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.c.

pos_x.description: Player actor + 0x0C pos.vx (s32). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.h WorldActor; WmGetPosFromPcEntity reads it.

pos_z.description: Player actor + 0x14 pos.vz (s32). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.h WorldActor.

dir.description: Player actor + 0x40 direction (s16). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.h WorldActor.
